title: Colony and Archive
author: Bram Eriksen
blurb: Silas Dravenmoor, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
